payload.title: eventTap uninstall reports nothing it leaves in place
payload.body: Assay of tap-uninstall-restores wants uninstall to name what it leaves in place (a settings file install made but the host added keys to; a directory install made but the host put a file in). EventTapHostClaude.remove() returns void (port ports/event-tap.ts) and dispatch.ts builds {verb:'uninstall'}; reporting needs a change to the port's remove return, dispatch.ts's uninstall result and EventTapResult, which the unit's outputs exclude (dispatch.ts is static there). Needs a unit or a revised spec that owns ports/event-tap.ts, dispatch.ts and their tests; the claude.ts side is a small return of the kept paths.
